tools.name: storerocket_get_user
tools.description: The StoreRocket user the API token belongs to: id, name, email and company. GET /user.

tools.name: storerocket_list_projects
tools.description: List the StoreRocket projects (store locators) the token's user belongs to: public id, name, number of locations, status and plan. Use the id as project_id in every location tool. Location tools need a project on the Business plan (API access). GET /projects.

tools.name: storerocket_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations of a project (name, address, city, coordinates, phone, visibility, location type, marker, cover image), 25 per page by default, with optional filters on name, address, city, state, country and postal code and optional hours/filters/custom fields/calls to action. Needs the location

tools.name: storerocket_get_location
tools.description: One location by id, optionally with its opening hours, search filters, custom fields and calls to action. Needs the location:read permission. GET /projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}.

tools.name: storerocket_create_location
tools.description: WRITE: add a location to a project's store locator. name and city are required; supply lat and lng for a precise pin (otherwise StoreRocket geocodes the address, which can be off). It appears on the live locator immediately unless visible is false, so set visible=false for a coming-soon or draft loc

tools.name: storerocket_update_location
tools.description: WRITE: change selected fields of one location with a partial update (PATCH): only the fields you send change, everything else is kept. The change shows on the live locator at once. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: storerocket_get_user, storerocket_create_location, storerocket_update_location · Private data: storerocket_get_user, storerocket_list_projects · Public sink: storerocket_get_user, storerocket_create_location, storerocket_update_location.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: storerocket_get_user, storerocket_create_location, storerocket_update_location · Private data: storerocket_get_user, storerocket_list_projects · Public sink: storerocket_get_user, storerocket_create_location, storerocket_update_location

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
